claims.text: Farm an Island is a Roblox Simulation / Tycoon by Boiler Games, place 78769336859161.
Players plant seeds, harvest crops, trade crops at the Bank for cash and buy more land.
The official description says chickens help players on their journey.
Boiler Games describes the game as receiving regular updates. Roblox lists an Aug 15, 2026 game update timestamp, but the current official source does not provide a dated change log.
At the Aug 17, 2026 check, Roblox reported 1,457 current players, 5,055,664 visits and 18,783 favorites.
A target-game video published Aug 7, 2026 shows THANKYOU awarding 2 Free Seed Packs and ILOVEGEARS awarding 3 Free Gears through Shop, Exclusive Shop, Codes and Redeem.
